World Screens.label: Allow web browsing on World Screens
World Screens.hint: Requires restarting Starfield. Browser screens load real websites, with their own cookies and sign-ins stored in the OSF UI profile folder. Turning this off stops web browsing on the next launch.

Developer.label: Developer mode
Developer.hint: Enable verbose diagnostics, F12 WebView DevTools, and loose-view hot reload on the next launch.
